systems.owner: Government of Uganda with Uganda Telecom, supported by UNICEF; registration under the National Identification and Registration Authority
systems.tiers: births and deaths registered in health facilities and villages, verified by back-office registration officers; the authority opening offices across districts

note: A study of identity systems and mobile operators in four countries; the Uganda chapter covers the national identity authority, birth registration and SIM registration, and says nothing of any local government office's connection.
